name: @operon/gatekeeper-browser
description: The web door (spec 0004): the browser Gatekeeper. One WebSession Durable Object per (agent, session name) relays CDP frames between the container side (arriving over the umbilical, binding-only) and a Cloudflare Browser Run session, holding the only Browser Run API token, ledgering session opens/closes and every top-frame navigation, with session recording enabled upstream.
